diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: Developer checks for test builds. Results stay on this phone until you share them.
diagnostics.keep_on: Keep the screen on and stay in the app. A full run takes up to 10 minutes.
diagnostics.build.invalid: Not a release Hermes build. Timings from this build are not valid.
diagnostics.build.no_commit: This build has no commit id, so its report cannot be compared. Use the preview-diagnostics build.
diagnostics.interrupted: The app went to the background, so the run stopped. Run it again.
diagnostics.failed: A check stopped on an error. Nothing was kept. Run it again.
diagnostics.share.notice: The file holds test results, app versions, and your phone model and system version. No identifiers, no match data.
diagnostics.share.needs: Run the reference results, then pick the memory and the phone class to share.
